meta.title: The Blackwood Lake Lights
meta.why: The string ties three lights in the sky to a man who vanished, every stop adds a detail that refuses to fit, and the stamp promises the video will not explain it away.
meta.facts: Fictional case, invented for this piece: Blackwood Lake, Alder County, the Alder Herald, the missing fisherman, the witnesses and every date and time. No real people or events are depicted.
